mechanisms.implementation: Tracks rival field harvests to infer rival inventory. Reorders existing SELL orders descending by rival-exposure price damage: _or2_exposure(item, qty, rival_stock). Preserves order multiset and non-SELL orders.
mechanisms.observed_trigger: Active every turn step >= 1 with >=2 movable SELL orders.
mechanisms.candidate_causal_explanation: Front-runs rival's impending sales on the exact commodities the rival has freshly harvested into shed, capturing peak price quotes before rival can execute.

mechanisms.implementation: When rival has harvested >= K units of an item, advances planned future sales of that item from future tape steps (horizon H=40 turns) into the current turn. Deducts advanced quantity from future tape sales ('debts') to preserve total production economics.
mechanisms.observed_trigger: Step 24 <= step < 694, rival harvest detected, available shed stock > 0, price >= 2.
mechanisms.candidate_causal_explanation: Captures current town demand and prevents opponent from dumping first; preserves macro production by not creating phantom inventory.

mechanisms.implementation: When all 10 order slots are full and high-exposure item has shed stock, drops weakest sale (lowest price exposure) and substitutes advanced sale of high-exposure item, returning debited slots.
mechanisms.observed_trigger: Step 288 <= step < 694, len(orders) >= 10, candidate gain > weakest gain + margin.
mechanisms.candidate_causal_explanation: Eliminates deadweight low-margin orders during peak capacity constraints to execute time-critical high-value sales.

mechanisms.implementation: Calculates nonlinear price degradation: Q * (P(Inv) - P(Inv + Q)) using exact 1.32.7 market pricing curves. Sorts SELL slots in-place by impact descending.
mechanisms.candidate_causal_explanation: Higher-volume / steeper-curve commodities execute in the first transaction sub-slots before own or concurrent market impact degrades price.

mechanisms.implementation: Multiplies market impact score by (1 + alpha * urgency) where urgency is recovery_days / 10. Items with lower town demand have longer recovery times, so they receive higher priority.
mechanisms.observed_trigger: Step >= 1 with >=2 SELL orders and unlocked shops.
mechanisms.candidate_causal_explanation: Towns absorb high-demand goods quickly, so prices recover. Low-demand goods suffer persistent price depression, making early sale much more valuable.

mechanisms.implementation: Intercepts PLANT/BUILD actions that collide with WEED tiles. Intercepting worker DIGs on step t, retries intended action on step t+1, then replays fixed-route steps for k turns.
mechanisms.observed_trigger: Worker attempts BUILD_PASTURE or PLANT on tile with kind == WEED.
mechanisms.candidate_causal_explanation: Prevents catastrophic route invalidation and permanent idle worker stall caused by random weed spawns.

mechanisms.implementation: At first planned COW purchase (step 144-192), checks open town shops. If no milk shops open and egg shop open, dynamically swaps purchase to GOOSE, rewrites pasture build to coop, and routes eggs to market.
mechanisms.observed_trigger: Step 144 <= step < 192, BUY_ANIMAL COW planned, shop condition satisfied.
mechanisms.candidate_causal_explanation: Cows require milk shops to be profitable; when town lacks milk demand, geese produce faster recurring egg cash without price depression.

mechanisms.implementation: Dynamic livestock EV evaluator at step 192-360. Computes expected revenue minus costs for GOOSE vs COW vs SHEEP given current market inventory, shop demand, and competitor animal counts.
mechanisms.observed_trigger: Step 192 <= step < 360, BUY_ANIMAL GOOSE planned, EV(best) >= 1.3 * EV(goose) and gain >= $600.
mechanisms.candidate_causal_explanation: Adapts livestock capex to the highest-demand animal product unlocked in town, preventing investment in saturated commodities.

mechanisms.implementation: Substitutes CARROT for WHEAT planting between days 6 and 28 if carrot book margin pays more and animal wheat feed reserves are guaranteed for >=2 days.
mechanisms.observed_trigger: Day 6-28, planting tile, feed reserve safe, carrot margin profitable.
mechanisms.candidate_causal_explanation: Carrot produces faster 4-day crop turnaround with high pet cafe / farmers market demand without starving livestock.

mechanisms.implementation: Projects end-of-day drop from workers returning to shed. If drop would exceed 40-unit shed capacity, preemptively sells surplus items before nightfall.
mechanisms.observed_trigger: Step % 24 in late turns of day, projected_shed > 40 capacity.
mechanisms.candidate_causal_explanation: Prevents catastrophic item loss where excess harvested goods are discarded by engine on night transition.

mechanisms.implementation: Harvests mature animals on days 28-29 that would otherwise produce uncollected yield before game end.
mechanisms.candidate_causal_explanation: Extracts maximum terminal cash value from capital assets on the final two days.
